style: Warm, calm and cheerful storyteller narrating a gentle hand-made paper-collage animated commercial, like a cosy picture-book narrator. A friendly smile in the voice, relaxed unhurried pacing, soft wonder, never salesy or loud. Line 1 a playful, delighted invitation. Line 2 light and bouncy, savouring each option, with small natural pauses at the commas. Line 3 warm and pleased, gently conclusive.
lines: Try on ten colour palettes, add a cover picture cropped just right, and give each category its own colour.
